scenes.title: 2 old motion lights → 2 Ring Floodlight Cam Pro
scenes.body: One covers the deck and sunroom, the other the backyard and hot tub.

scenes.title: Ring Floodlight Cam Pro (2nd Gen, wired)
scenes.body: 4K video, 3D motion detection, and bright LED floodlights in one unit.

scenes.title: Two LED floodlights + a 4K camera
scenes.body: One unit replaces the old motion light on the same box.

scenes.title: Power off, old light removed
scenes.body: Breaker off and tested before we touch a wire. The existing box is reused.

scenes.title: Wired to the existing fixture box
scenes.body: Hot, neutral and ground connected, then sealed against the weather.

scenes.title: Mounted, aimed and connected
scenes.body: Deck, sunroom, backyard and hot tub covered. Motion turns the lights on and sends an alert in the Ring app.
